title: Carmina Vol 1
author: Damasus I
source: Translated by Claude from stoa0105.stoa004.opp-lat1, as held by Open Greek and Latin's Patrologia Latina.
statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

passages.original: Eusebius miseros docuit sua crimina flere.
passages.english: Eusebius taught the wretched to weep for their sins.
passages.notes: "crimina" (literally "crimes") is taken in its common Christian sense of sins. "sua" may refer to the wretched (their own sins) or, less naturally, to Eusebius; the first reading is adopted.
